exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions:
Eyes under the bar, feet planted, shoulder blades pinched
Grip just outside shoulder width, wrists stacked over elbows
Lower under control to mid/lower chest, elbows ~45°
Press up and slightly back toward your face
Keep glutes on the bench throughout

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions:
Set bench to 30-45°, eyes just under the bar
Pinch shoulder blades and plant feet before unracking
Lower to upper chest just below the collarbones
Press straight up over the shoulders, not toward your face
Keep glutes down; don't arch into a flat bench

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions:
Lock legs under the pads before taking the bar
Use a spotter or safeties for the unrack
Grip just outside shoulder width, shoulder blades pinched
Lower to lower chest, elbows ~45° from torso
Press up over the shoulders without bouncing off the chest

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.instructions:
Grip about shoulder width, not narrower
Pinch shoulder blades, feet planted
Lower to lower chest with elbows tucked close to sides
Press up by driving through the triceps
Keep wrists straight; don't let them bend back

exercises.name: Paused Bench Press
exercises.instructions:
Set up as a normal bench: blades pinched, feet planted
Lower under control to mid/lower chest
Hold a full still pause on the chest, stay tight
Press hard off the chest without heaving the hips
Don't relax or sink the bar into your chest during the pause

exercises.name: Barbell Floor Press
exercises.instructions:
Lie under the bar in a rack, knees bent or legs straight
Grip just outside shoulder width, blades pinched
Lower until upper arms rest on the floor, elbows ~45°
Pause briefly, then press up without bouncing the elbows
Keep wrists stacked over elbows throughout

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions:
Kick dumbbells up off your knees as you lie back
Pinch shoulder blades, feet planted
Lower to chest level, elbows ~45°, wrists over elbows
Press up and slightly together, without clanking
Control the bottom; don't let elbows drop too deep

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions:
Set bench to 30-45°, kick dumbbells up from knees
Pinch shoulder blades into the bench, feet planted
Lower to upper chest, elbows slightly tucked
Press up over the shoulders, slightly together
Keep glutes on the bench; don't flare elbows wide

exercises.name: Decline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions:
Hook legs under the pads, then lie back holding the dumbbells
Pinch shoulder blades, dumbbells over lower chest
Lower to lower chest, elbows ~45°
Press up and slightly together
Bring dumbbells to your chest before sitting up to finish

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.instructions:
Lie on the floor, knees bent, dumbbells over chest
Pinch shoulder blades into the floor
Lower until upper arms touch the floor, elbows ~45°
Pause, then press up without bouncing the elbows
Keep wrists straight over elbows

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions:
Hold one dumbbell, brace your core, feet planted wide
Pinch shoulder blades; keep both shoulders on the bench
Lower to chest, elbow ~45°
Press up without rotating your torso toward the weight
Finish all reps, then switch sides

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
exercises.instructions:
Position bench so the bar lowers to mid/lower chest
Pinch shoulder blades, feet planted
Grip just outside shoulder width, unhook by rotating wrists
Lower under control, elbows ~45°, press straight up
Set safety stops and re-hook the bar after the last rep

exercises.name: Smith Machine Incline Press
exercises.instructions:
Set bench to 30-45° so the bar lands on upper chest
Pinch shoulder blades, feet planted
Unhook and lower under control to upper chest
Press straight up without locking out hard
Set safety stops; keep glutes on the bench

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.instructions:
Set seat so handles line up with mid-chest
Sit tall, shoulder blades back against the pad
Press forward until arms are nearly straight
Return slowly until you feel a chest stretch
Don't let shoulders roll forward at lockout

exercises.name: Incline Machine Press
exercises.instructions:
Set seat so handles start near upper chest
Keep back and shoulder blades against the pad
Press up and forward along the machine's path
Lower slowly to a comfortable stretch
Don't shrug or lift your hips off the seat

exercises.name: Cable Chest Press
exercises.instructions:
Set pulleys at chest height, step forward into a split stance
Start with handles beside chest, elbows ~45°
Press forward and slightly together until arms are straight
Return slowly, feeling a chest stretch
Brace your core; don't let the cables pull you back

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions:
Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line
Squeeze glutes and brace abs
Lower chest toward the floor, elbows ~45°
Push the floor away until arms are straight
Don't let hips sag or pike up

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.instructions:
Hands on a bench edge, slightly wider than shoulders
Body straight from head to heels, core braced
Lower chest to the bench, elbows ~45°
Push back up to straight arms
Keep hips in line; don't let them sag

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
exercises.instructions:
Feet on a bench, hands on floor slightly wider than shoulders
Brace core and glutes to keep a straight line
Lower chest toward the floor, elbows ~45°
Push back up to straight arms
Don't let hips pike up or lower back sag

exercises.name: Diamond Push-Up
exercises.instructions:
Hands together under chest, fingers forming a diamond
Body straight, core and glutes braced
Lower chest to hands, elbows tracking back
Press up by squeezing the triceps
Don't let elbows flare out wide

exercises.name: Banded Push-Up
exercises.instructions:
Wrap band across upper back, ends under each hand
Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body straight
Lower chest toward the floor, elbows ~45°
Push up hard against the band to straight arms
Keep hips level; don't let them sag at the top

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.instructions:
Grip bars, start with arms locked, shoulders down
Lean torso forward, knees slightly bent behind
Lower until upper arms are about parallel to the floor
Press back up while keeping the forward lean
Don't drop too deep or let shoulders roll forward

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.instructions:
Bar on front delts, grip just outside shoulders
Squeeze glutes and brace abs, elbows slightly ahead of bar
Press straight up, moving your head back to clear the bar
Push head through at the top, bar over mid-foot
Don't lean back or arch the lower back

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.instructions:
Bar on front delts, grip just outside shoulders
Dip a few inches by bending knees, torso upright
Drive hard through legs to launch the bar
Finish by pressing to lockout, head through
Keep the dip short and straight; don't let knees cave

exercises.name: Z Press
exercises.instructions:
Sit on the floor, legs straight out in a wide V
Bar on front delts, sit tall with core braced
Press straight up, head moving back to clear the bar
Lock out with bar over the back of your head
Don't lean back or round your lower back

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions:
Set bench upright, kick dumbbells to shoulder height
Back against the pad, core braced, feet planted
Press up and slightly in until arms are straight
Lower to about ear level under control
Don't arch off the pad or flare elbows straight out

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions:
Stand hip-width, dumbbells at shoulders
Squeeze glutes and brace abs
Press up and slightly in until arms are straight
Lower under control to shoulder level
Don't lean back or use leg drive

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.instructions:
Sit upright, dumbbells in front of shoulders, palms facing you
Rotate palms forward as you press up
Finish with arms straight, palms forward
Reverse the rotation on the way down
Keep core braced; don't arch your lower back

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions:
Stand tall, one dumbbell at shoulder, free hand on hip
Brace core and squeeze glutes
Press straight up to lockout
Lower under control to the shoulder
Don't lean away from the weight; switch sides after the set

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions:
Set seat so handles start at shoulder height
Back against the pad, core braced
Press up until arms are nearly straight
Lower slowly to shoulder level
Don't shrug or arch off the pad

exercises.name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions:
Set bench upright so the bar lowers in front of your face
Grip just outside shoulders, back against the pad
Unhook and lower to about chin level
Press straight up to near lockout
Set safety stops; don't arch off the bench

exercises.name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
exercises.instructions:
Clean the bell to the rack, handle in palm, bell on forearm
Squeeze glutes, brace abs, wrist straight
Press up, rotating palm to face forward
Lock out with bicep near your ear
Don't lean back; switch sides after the set

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.instructions:
Hold the bar end at shoulder in a staggered stance
Brace core, ribs down
Press up and forward along the bar's arc
Reach fully at the top, then lower under control
Don't twist or lean back; switch sides after the set

exercises.name: Banded Overhead Press
exercises.instructions:
Stand on the band, handles at shoulders
Squeeze glutes and brace abs
Press straight up until arms are straight
Lower under control against the band
Don't arch your back or let elbows flare wide

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.instructions:
Hands shoulder-width, hips high in an inverted V
Walk feet close so torso is near vertical
Lower the top of your head toward the floor in front of hands
Press back up to straight arms
Keep hips high; don't let it become a regular push-up

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Up
exercises.instructions:
Kick up to a handstand against a wall, hands shoulder-width
Brace core and squeeze glutes, body straight
Lower head to the floor in a tripod with your hands
Press back up to straight arms
Lower under control; don't crash onto your head

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.instructions:
Hinge to ~45°, bar hanging at knees, back flat
Grip just outside knees, brace core
Row bar to lower ribs, driving elbows back
Lower under control to full arm extension
Don't stand up or jerk the weight with your hips

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.instructions:
Hinge until torso is near parallel, bar on the floor
Back flat, grip just outside shoulders
Row explosively to lower chest
Return the bar to the floor each rep
Keep torso still; don't lift with your back

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions:
One knee and hand on the bench, back flat
Let the dumbbell hang straight below the shoulder
Row toward your hip, elbow close to your side
Lower to a full stretch under control
Don't twist your torso; switch sides after the set

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions:
Lie face down on an incline bench, chest on the pad
Let dumbbells hang straight down
Row toward hips, squeezing shoulder blades together
Lower to a full stretch
Keep chest on the pad; don't lift up to cheat

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions:
Sit tall, feet on platform, knees slightly bent
Start with arms straight and a slight forward stretch
Row handle to lower ribs, shoulder blades squeezed
Return slowly to full arm extension
Don't rock your torso back to move the weight

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Row
exercises.instructions:
Set pulley at chest height, staggered stance or seated
Start with arm straight and a slight reach
Row to your side, elbow tight to your body
Return under control to a full stretch
Don't rotate your torso; switch sides after the set

exercises.name: Seated Machine Row
exercises.instructions:
Set seat so handles are at mid-chest, chest on pad
Sit tall with arms straight
Row back, squeezing shoulder blades together
Return slowly to a full stretch
Keep chest on the pad; don't jerk back

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.instructions:
Straddle the bar, hinge to ~45°, back flat
Grip handle with arms straight, core braced
Row toward your lower chest, elbows back
Lower under control to full extension
Don't stand up or bounce the weight

exercises.name: Meadows Row
exercises.instructions:
Stand side-on to the bar end, staggered stance
Hinge, grip the bar sleeve overhand, free arm on knee
Row up and back toward your hip, elbow high
Lower to a full stretch
Keep hips square; switch sides after the set

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.instructions:
Set bar at hip height in a rack, lie under it
Grip just outside shoulders, body straight, heels down
Pull chest to the bar, shoulder blades squeezed
Lower under control to straight arms
Don't let hips sag; keep a straight line

exercises.name: Smith Machine Row
exercises.instructions:
Set bar at knee height, hinge to ~45° with flat back
Grip just outside knees, brace core
Row to lower ribs, elbows back
Lower under control to straight arms
Don't stand up or jerk with your hips

exercises.name: Kettlebell Row
exercises.instructions:
Hinge with flat back, free hand on bench or knee
Let the bell hang under your shoulder
Row toward your hip, elbow close
Lower to a full stretch
Don't twist; switch sides after the set

exercises.name: Banded Row
exercises.instructions:
Anchor band at chest height, step back to add tension
Stand or sit tall, arms straight
Row handles to lower ribs, squeeze shoulder blades
Return slowly against the band
Don't lean back to finish the rep

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.instructions:
Grip overhand just wider than shoulders
Start from a dead hang, shoulders pulled down
Pull chest toward the bar, elbows driving down
Get chin over the bar, then lower under control
Don't kip or swing; return to full hang

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.instructions:
Grip underhand, shoulder width
Start from a dead hang, shoulders pulled down
Pull chest to the bar, elbows close to your sides
Get chin over the bar, then lower under control
Don't swing or cut the bottom short

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.instructions:
Grip parallel handles, palms facing each other
Start from a dead hang, shoulders pulled down
Pull chest toward the handles, elbows down
Get chin above handles, then lower under control
Don't swing; keep legs still

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.instructions:
Attach weight with a belt or hold a dumbbell between feet
Grip overhand just wider than shoulders, dead hang
Pull shoulders down, then chest toward the bar
Get chin over, then lower to a full hang
Don't kip or shorten the range with added load

exercises.name: Negative Pull-Up
exercises.instructions:
Step or jump up so chin is over the bar
Hold the top with shoulders pulled down
Lower as slowly as you can, 3-5 seconds
Reach a full dead hang at the bottom
Don't drop the last part; control it all the way

exercises.name: Band-Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.instructions:
Loop band over the bar, place a knee or foot in it
Grip overhand just wider than shoulders, dead hang
Pull chest toward the bar, elbows down
Get chin over, then lower under control
Don't bounce out of the bottom with the band

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up Machine
exercises.instructions:
Set assistance weight; more weight means more help
Kneel or stand on the platform, grip the handles
Pull chest up, driving elbows down
Lower under control to straight arms
Don't use momentum from the platform

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions:
Grip just wider than shoulders, thighs under the pad
Sit tall with a slight lean back
Pull bar to upper chest, elbows driving down
Return slowly to straight arms
Don't pull behind the neck or swing your torso

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions:
Use a V-handle or close grip, thighs locked under pad
Sit tall with a slight lean back
Pull handle to upper chest, elbows close to your sides
Return slowly to a full stretch
Don't rock back to move the weight

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions:
Grip one handle, sit or kneel under the pulley
Start with arm fully extended overhead
Pull elbow down toward your hip
Return slowly to a full stretch
Don't lean or twist; switch sides after the set

exercises.name: Machine Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions:
Adjust seat and thigh pad so you're locked in
Grip handles with arms straight overhead
Pull down, driving elbows toward your hips
Return slowly to a full stretch
Don't shrug or lean back excessively

exercises.name: Banded Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions:
Anchor band high, kneel or sit facing it
Arms straight overhead with tension in the band
Pull elbows down toward your sides
Return slowly against the band
Keep torso upright; don't lean back to cheat

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.instructions:
Set pulley high, step back, hinge slightly forward
Grip bar or rope, arms nearly straight
Sweep bar down to your thighs using your lats
Return slowly until arms are overhead
Don't bend the elbows to turn it into a pushdown

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.instructions:
Lie across or along a bench, dumbbell over chest
Hold one dumbbell with both hands, elbows slightly bent
Lower it back behind your head to a stretch
Pull it back over your chest along the same arc
Keep ribs down; don't over-arch your lower back

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.instructions:
Bar on upper back, hands snug, elbows under the bar
Feet about shoulder width, toes slightly out
Brace, then sit down and back between your hips
Drive up through mid-foot, knees tracking over toes
Keep chest up; don't let knees cave in

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.instructions:
Bar on front delts, elbows high, fingertips under bar
Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out
Sit straight down with torso upright
Drive up leading with elbows and chest
Don't let elbows drop or upper back round

exercises.name: Paused Squat
exercises.instructions:
Set up as a back squat, brace hard
Descend under control to depth
Hold a still 2-3 second pause, staying tight
Drive up from the pause without bouncing
Don't relax or let the chest fall during the pause

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.instructions:
Set a box so you sit at or just below parallel
Bar on upper back, stance slightly wide
Sit back onto the box under control
Pause briefly while staying braced, then drive up
Don't plop down or rock back on the box

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions:
Hold the dumbbell vertically at chest, elbows down
Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out
Sit down between your hips, elbows inside knees
Drive up through mid-foot, chest tall
Don't let heels lift or knees cave

exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions:
Hold the bell by the horns at chest height
Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out
Sit down between your hips, chest up
Drive up through mid-foot to standing
Don't let the bell pull your torso forward

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat
exercises.instructions:
Hold dumbbells at your sides, arms straight
Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out
Sit down and back, chest up
Drive up through mid-foot, knees over toes
Don't let knees cave or heels lift

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.instructions:
Bar on upper back, feet slightly in front of the bar
Unhook and brace your core
Sit down until thighs are about parallel
Drive up through your whole foot
Set safety stops; don't let knees cave

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.instructions:
Back and shoulders flat on the pad, feet mid-platform
Release the safeties and brace
Lower until thighs are about parallel or deeper
Drive up through your whole foot
Don't let hips lift off the pad or knees cave

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions:
Back flat on the pad, feet shoulder width mid-platform
Release safeties and lower the sled under control
Go as deep as you can without your lower back rounding
Press through your whole foot to near lockout
Don't lock knees hard or let hips lift off the seat

exercises.name: Single-Leg Press
exercises.instructions:
Place one foot mid-platform, other foot off to the side
Back flat on the pad, release safeties
Lower under control to a comfortable depth
Press through your whole foot, knee tracking over toes
Use lighter weight; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat
exercises.instructions:
Shoulders under the pads, back flat, feet mid-platform
Release the lock and brace
Lower deep, letting knees travel forward
Drive up through your whole foot
Don't let hips peel off the pad

exercises.name: Belt Squat
exercises.instructions:
Attach the belt at your hips, stand on the platform
Feet shoulder width, hold the handles lightly
Squat down with torso upright
Drive up through mid-foot to standing
Don't let knees cave or pull with your arms

exercises.name: Landmine Squat
exercises.instructions:
Hold the bar end at your chest with both hands
Feet shoulder width, lean slightly into the bar
Sit down between your hips, chest up
Drive up through mid-foot
Don't let knees cave or heels lift

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.instructions:
Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out
Arms forward for balance, chest up
Sit down and back to at least parallel
Drive up through your whole foot
Don't let heels lift or knees cave

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
exercises.instructions:
Stand on one leg, other leg extended forward
Arms forward for balance, core braced
Sit down slowly, knee tracking over toes
Drive up through your whole foot
Hold a support if needed; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Conventional Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Bar over mid-foot, feet hip-width, shins close
Grip just outside legs, pull slack out of the bar
Chest up, back flat, brace hard
Push the floor away, bar dragging up your legs
Lock out with glutes; don't lean back or round

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Wide stance, toes out, bar over mid-foot
Grip inside legs, arms straight down
Push knees out, hips down, chest up
Push the floor apart and stand up, bar close
Don't let hips shoot up first or knees cave

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Stand centered in the bar, feet hip-width
Grip handles in the middle, back flat
Brace and push the floor away
Stand tall, squeezing glutes at the top
Don't round your back or jerk the bar

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Start standing, bar at hips, grip shoulder width
Soft knees, push hips straight back
Lower bar along thighs until hamstrings stretch
Drive hips forward to stand tall
Keep back flat; don't turn it into a squat

exercises.name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Bar over mid-foot, feet hip-width
Knees only slightly bent and fixed
Hinge down with a flat back to the floor or stretch
Stand up by driving hips forward
Don't round your lower back to reach lower

exercises.name: Deficit Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Stand on a 2-5 cm plate or platform, bar over mid-foot
Hips lower than usual, back flat, chest up
Pull slack out of the bar and brace
Push the floor away, bar close to legs
Use less weight; don't let your back round off the floor

exercises.name: Paused Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Set up as a regular deadlift, brace hard
Pull bar just off the floor or to below the knee
Hold a 1-2 second pause with back flat
Continue to lockout, bar close
Don't lose tightness or let the bar drift forward

exercises.name: Rack Pull
exercises.instructions:
Set pins so the bar sits at or just below the knee
Feet hip-width, grip just outside legs
Back flat, brace and pull slack out
Drive hips forward to lock out
Don't lean back or shrug at the top

exercises.name: Good Morning
exercises.instructions:
Bar on upper back, feet hip-width, soft knees
Brace core and keep back flat
Push hips back, lowering torso toward parallel
Drive hips forward to stand up
Use light weight; stop before your back rounds

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Stand tall, dumbbells in front of thighs
Soft knees, push hips straight back
Slide dumbbells down your legs to a hamstring stretch
Drive hips forward to stand
Keep back flat; don't reach with the shoulders

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Stand on one leg, dumbbell in the opposite hand
Soft standing knee, hinge forward at the hip
Let back leg rise in line with your torso
Return to standing by driving the hip forward
Keep hips square; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Stand close to the bar, grip shoulder width
Unhook, soft knees, back flat
Push hips back until hamstrings stretch
Drive hips forward to stand
Set safety stops; don't round the lower back

exercises.name: Kettlebell Deadlift
exercises.instructions:
Bell between feet, feet hip-width
Hinge down, grip the handle, back flat
Brace and stand up by driving through your feet
Squeeze glutes at the top
Don't round your back or squat it up

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.instructions:
Bell a foot in front, hinge and grip the handle
Hike the bell back high between your legs
Snap hips forward to float the bell to chest height
Let it fall back and hinge to catch it
Don't lift with your arms or squat the swing

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.instructions:
Set rope low, face away and straddle the cable
Walk forward, feet hip-width, soft knees
Hinge back letting the rope pass between legs
Drive hips forward and squeeze glutes to stand
Don't pull with your arms or lean back at the top

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.instructions:
Set pad just below your hip crease, heels locked in
Arms crossed or hands by your head
Lower torso under control by hinging at the hips
Rise until body is straight, squeeze glutes
Don't hyperextend at the top

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
exercises.instructions:
Lie face down, hips at the edge, grip the handles
Hook ankles in the strap or let legs hang
Raise legs by squeezing glutes until in line with torso
Lower under control, letting legs swing under
Don't kick up past horizontal

exercises.name: Banded Good Morning
exercises.instructions:
Stand on the band, loop it behind your neck
Feet hip-width, soft knees, back flat
Push hips back until torso is near parallel
Drive hips forward to stand tall
Don't round your back to get lower

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions:
Hold dumbbells at sides, stand tall
Take a long step, lower back knee toward the floor
Front knee tracks over toes, torso upright
Drive through front heel and step into the next lunge
Don't let the front knee cave in

exercises.name: Barbell Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions:
Bar on upper back, brace core
Take a long step, lower back knee toward the floor
Keep torso upright, front knee over toes
Drive through front heel into the next step
Clear space first; don't let knees cave

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
exercises.instructions:
Hold dumbbells at sides, feet hip-width
Step one foot back and lower back knee toward floor
Keep torso upright, front shin near vertical
Drive through front heel to return to standing
Alternate or finish one side, then switch

exercises.name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
exercises.instructions:
Bar on upper back, feet hip-width, brace
Step back and lower back knee toward the floor
Keep torso upright, front knee over toes
Drive through front heel to stand
Step back carefully; don't lose balance

exercises.name: Bodyweight Lunge
exercises.instructions:
Stand tall, hands on hips
Step forward and lower back knee toward the floor
Front knee tracks over toes, torso upright
Push through front heel to return
Alternate legs; don't let the front knee cave

exercises.name: Dumbbell Split Squat
exercises.instructions:
Hold dumbbells at sides, staggered stance
Lower straight down until back knee nears the floor
Keep torso upright, front knee over toes
Drive through the front foot to stand
Stay in place; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions:
Rear foot laces-down on a bench, front foot forward
Hold dumbbells at sides, core braced
Lower straight down until front thigh is near parallel
Drive through the front foot to stand
Don't push off the back foot; switch legs after

exercises.name: Smith Machine Split Squat
exercises.instructions:
Bar on upper back, staggered stance
Unhook and brace
Lower until back knee nears the floor
Drive through the front foot to stand
Set safety stops; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
exercises.instructions:
Hold dumbbells at sides, one foot fully on the bench
Lean slightly forward over the front foot
Drive through the front heel to stand on the bench
Lower under control with the same leg
Don't push off the back foot; switch legs after

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
exercises.instructions:
Hold a dumbbell at chest, feet together
Step wide to one side, toes forward
Sit hips back over the stepping leg, other leg straight
Push off to return to center
Keep chest up; alternate or switch sides after

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.instructions:
Very wide stance, toes slightly out
Shift and sit deep over one leg
Keep the other leg straight, toes pointing up
Push back through center to the other side
Keep heel down on the bent leg; chest up

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions:
Upper back on bench edge, bar padded over hips
Feet flat, shins vertical at the top
Tuck chin, brace, drive hips up through heels
Squeeze glutes hard at the top, ribs down
Don't overarch your lower back to finish

exercises.name: Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.instructions:
Set the pad across your hips, back on the support
Feet flat, about hip-width
Drive hips up through your heels
Squeeze glutes at the top, then lower slowly
Don't arch your lower back to finish

exercises.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions:
Upper back on the bench, bar padded across hips
Feet flat, shins vertical at the top
Unhook and drive hips up through heels
Squeeze glutes at the top, ribs down
Set safety stops; don't overarch

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions:
Upper back on bench, dumbbell held on hips
Feet flat, shins vertical at the top
Drive hips up through your heels
Squeeze glutes at the top, chin tucked
Don't arch the lower back to get higher

exercises.name: Banded Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions:
Upper back on bench, band across hips anchored low
Feet flat, about hip-width
Drive hips up through heels against the band
Squeeze glutes at the top, then lower slowly
Keep ribs down; don't overarch

exercises.name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions:
Upper back on bench, one foot flat, other leg raised
Brace and drive hips up through the planted heel
Squeeze the glute at the top, hips level
Lower under control
Don't let hips rotate; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat hip-width
Brace core, press lower back down
Drive hips up through your heels
Squeeze glutes at the top, then lower slowly
Don't arch your lower back at the top

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions:
Lie on the floor, padded bar over hips
Knees bent, feet flat hip-width
Drive hips up through your heels
Squeeze glutes at the top, ribs down
Lower under control; don't overarch

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your back, one foot flat, other leg raised
Press through the planted heel to lift hips
Squeeze the glute at the top, hips level
Lower under control
Don't let hips tilt; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
exercises.instructions:
Ankle strap on, face the low pulley, hold the frame
Hinge slightly, brace core
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch
Don't arch your lower back; switch legs after

exercises.name: Glute Kickback Machine
exercises.instructions:
Set up on the machine, foot on the pad
Brace core, hips square
Push the leg back by squeezing the glute
Return slowly under control
Don't arch your lower back; switch legs after

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
exercises.instructions:
Pick up heavy dumbbells with a flat back
Stand tall, shoulders down and back
Walk with short, steady steps
Grip hard and keep the weights still
Don't lean or shrug; set down with a flat back

exercises.name: Trap Bar Carry
exercises.instructions:
Stand in the bar, deadlift it up with a flat back
Stand tall, shoulders back, core braced
Walk with short, controlled steps
Keep the bar level and still
Set down by hinging, not rounding

exercises.name: Kettlebell Farmer's Carry
exercises.instructions:
Deadlift the bells up with a flat back
Stand tall, shoulders down, bells at your sides
Walk with short, steady steps
Grip hard; keep bells from swinging
Don't lean or shrug while walking

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.instructions:
Pick up one dumbbell at your side with a flat back
Stand tall, shoulders level
Walk with short, steady steps
Brace your core to resist leaning
Don't tilt toward the weight; switch sides

exercises.name: Overhead Carry
exercises.instructions:
Press the dumbbells overhead, arms locked
Biceps by ears, ribs down, core braced
Walk with short, steady steps
Keep weights stacked over shoulders
Don't arch your back; lower carefully at the end

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
exercises.instructions:
Lie on a flat bench, dumbbells over chest, palms in
Keep a slight, fixed bend in the elbows
Open arms wide until you feel a chest stretch
Squeeze back up in a hugging arc
Don't go too deep or turn it into a press

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
exercises.instructions:
Set bench to 30-45°, dumbbells over upper chest
Keep a slight, fixed bend in the elbows
Open arms wide to a chest stretch
Bring them back up in a hugging arc
Don't drop the elbows below shoulder level

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.instructions:
Set pulleys high, step forward into a split stance
Lean slightly forward, slight bend in elbows
Sweep hands down and together in front of your hips
Return slowly until you feel a chest stretch
Keep elbow bend fixed; don't press the handles

exercises.name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
exercises.instructions:
Set pulleys low, step forward, palms facing up
Slight bend in elbows, chest up
Sweep hands up and together to upper chest height
Return slowly to a stretch
Don't shrug or swing your torso

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.instructions:
Set seat so handles are at chest height
Back flat against the pad, slight bend in elbows
Bring handles together in front of your chest
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch
Don't let shoulders roll forward

exercises.name: Banded Chest Fly
exercises.instructions:
Anchor band behind you at chest height
Arms out wide, slight bend in elbows
Bring hands together in front of your chest
Return slowly against the band
Keep elbow bend fixed; don't lean forward

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions:
Stand tall, dumbbells at sides, slight bend in elbows
Lean very slightly forward
Raise arms out to the sides to shoulder height
Lower slowly under control
Lead with elbows; don't swing or shrug

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions:
Set pulley low, stand side-on, handle in far hand
Slight bend in elbow, brace core
Raise the arm out to shoulder height
Lower slowly, keeping tension
Don't lean away or shrug; switch sides after

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions:
Set seat so shoulders line up with the pivot
Pads against the outside of your arms
Raise arms out to shoulder height
Lower slowly under control
Don't shrug or lean to move the weight

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions:
Stand on the band, handles at your sides
Slight bend in elbows, stand tall
Raise arms out to shoulder height
Lower slowly against the band
Don't shrug or swing

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercises.instructions:
Stand tall, dumbbells in front of thighs
Slight bend in elbows, core braced
Raise arms forward to shoulder height
Lower slowly under control
Don't lean back or swing the weights

exercises.name: Cable Front Raise
exercises.instructions:
Set pulley low, face away, handle between legs
Slight bend in elbow, core braced
Raise forward to shoulder height
Lower slowly, keeping tension
Don't lean back or swing

exercises.name: Upright Row
exercises.instructions:
Grip the bar about shoulder width, arms straight
Stand tall, core braced
Pull bar up close to your body, elbows leading
Stop around chest height, elbows at shoulder level
Don't pull higher if shoulders pinch; lower slowly

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions:
Set rope at face height, grip with thumbs toward you
Step back with arms straight, stand tall
Pull rope toward your face, elbows high and wide
Pull ends apart and rotate hands back at the end
Don't lean back or shrug

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.instructions:
Face the pad, set handles so arms are straight ahead
Chest on the pad, slight bend in elbows
Sweep arms back and out to the sides
Return slowly under control
Don't shrug or squeeze blades too hard

exercises.name: Bent-Over Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions:
Hinge forward with a flat back, dumbbells hanging
Slight bend in elbows, palms facing in
Raise arms out to the sides, leading with elbows
Lower slowly under control
Don't swing your torso or shrug

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions:
Set pulleys at shoulder height, cross the cables
Grip opposite handles, arms straight in front
Sweep arms back and out to the sides
Return slowly under control
Don't lean back or bend the elbows more

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.instructions:
Hold the band at shoulder height, arms straight
Grip about shoulder width, stand tall
Pull the band apart toward your chest
Return slowly under control
Don't shrug or arch your lower back

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.instructions:
Hold the bar at your thighs, grip shoulder width
Stand tall, arms straight
Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears
Pause briefly, then lower slowly
Don't roll your shoulders or bend the elbows

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shrug
exercises.instructions:
Hold dumbbells at your sides, stand tall
Arms straight, core braced
Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears
Pause briefly, then lower slowly
Don't roll your shoulders or bend the elbows

exercises.name: Trap Bar Shrug
exercises.instructions:
Stand in the bar, deadlift it up
Stand tall, arms straight
Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears
Pause at the top, then lower slowly
Don't roll the shoulders or bend the elbows

exercises.name: Smith Machine Shrug
exercises.instructions:
Stand close to the bar, grip shoulder width
Unhook and stand tall, arms straight
Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears
Pause, then lower slowly
Don't roll the shoulders; re-hook after the set

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions:
Grip the bar shoulder width, palms up
Stand tall, elbows at your sides
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders
Lower slowly to straight arms
Don't swing your hips or move your elbows forward

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
exercises.instructions:
Grip the angled part of the EZ bar, palms up
Stand tall, elbows at your sides
Curl the bar toward your shoulders
Lower slowly to straight arms
Don't lean back or swing the weight

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions:
Stand tall, dumbbells at sides, palms forward
Keep elbows pinned to your sides
Curl up, squeezing at the top
Lower slowly to straight arms
Don't swing; alternate or curl together

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions:
Stand tall, dumbbells at sides, palms facing in
Keep elbows pinned to your sides
Curl up with palms staying neutral
Lower slowly to straight arms
Don't swing your body to lift the weight

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions:
Set bench to about 45-60°, lie back
Let arms hang straight down, palms forward
Curl up without moving the upper arm forward
Lower slowly to a full stretch
Keep shoulders back against the bench

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions:
Set seat so armpits rest on the top of the pad
Grip the EZ bar's angled part, arms on the pad
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders
Lower slowly to almost straight arms
Don't drop fast into the bottom or lift off the pad

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl
exercises.instructions:
Set seat so upper arms rest flat on the pad
Grip handles, arms almost straight
Curl up, squeezing the biceps
Lower slowly to near full extension
Don't lift elbows off the pad or jerk the weight

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.instructions:
Sit on a bench, elbow braced inside your thigh
Let the dumbbell hang with arm straight
Curl up toward your shoulder
Lower slowly to straight arm
Don't move the elbow; switch arms after the set

exercises.name: Spider Curl
exercises.instructions:
Lie chest-down on an incline bench
Let arms hang straight down, palms up
Curl up without moving upper arms
Squeeze at the top, lower slowly
Keep chest on the pad; don't swing

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.instructions:
Set pulley low, grip bar palms up
Stand tall, elbows at your sides
Curl the bar up to your shoulders
Lower slowly, keeping tension
Don't lean back or let elbows drift forward

exercises.name: Bayesian Cable Curl
exercises.instructions:
Set pulley low, face away, handle in one hand
Step forward so arm is pulled behind your body
Curl up while keeping the elbow back
Lower slowly to a full stretch
Don't let the elbow swing forward; switch arms

exercises.name: Banded Curl
exercises.instructions:
Stand on the band, handles palms up
Elbows at your sides, stand tall
Curl up toward your shoulders
Lower slowly against the band
Don't swing or move elbows forward

exercises.name: Reverse Curl
exercises.instructions:
Grip the EZ bar overhand, shoulder width
Stand tall, elbows at your sides
Curl up keeping wrists straight
Lower slowly to straight arms
Don't swing or let wrists bend back

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.instructions:
Set pulley high, grip bar overhand
Stand tall, elbows pinned at your sides
Push down until arms are straight
Return slowly to about 90° at the elbow
Don't let elbows drift forward or lean over the bar

exercises.name: Rope Pushdown
exercises.instructions:
Set pulley high, grip the rope ends
Elbows pinned at your sides, stand tall
Push down and spread the rope apart at the bottom
Return slowly to about 90°
Don't let elbows flare or move forward

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
exercises.instructions:
Set pulley high, grip handle in one hand
Elbow pinned at your side
Push down until the arm is straight
Return slowly under control
Don't lean into it; switch arms after the set

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions:
Set pulley low or mid, face away holding rope overhead
Staggered stance, elbows pointing forward
Extend arms until straight overhead
Return slowly to a deep stretch behind your head
Keep elbows narrow; don't arch your lower back

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
exercises.instructions:
Lie on a bench, EZ bar over your shoulders
Tilt arms slightly back toward your head
Bend elbows to lower bar toward your forehead
Extend arms to return to the start
Keep elbows in; don't let them flare

exercises.name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
exercises.instructions:
Lie on a bench, dumbbells over shoulders, palms in
Keep upper arms still and slightly angled back
Lower dumbbells beside your head
Extend arms back to straight
Don't let elbows flare or drop the weights fast

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions:
Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands
Stand or sit tall, core braced
Lower it behind your head, elbows pointing up
Extend arms back to straight
Keep elbows narrow; don't arch your back

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback
exercises.instructions:
Hinge forward, upper arm parallel to the floor
Brace with free hand on bench or knee
Extend the arm back until straight
Lower slowly to 90°
Keep upper arm still; switch sides if doing one arm

exercises.name: Banded Pushdown
exercises.instructions:
Anchor band high, grip the ends
Elbows pinned at your sides
Push down until arms are straight
Return slowly to about 90°
Don't lean over or let elbows move forward

exercises.name: JM Press
exercises.instructions:
Lie on a bench, grip the bar about shoulder width
Start with bar over shoulders, elbows tucked
Lower bar toward your chin by bending elbows forward
Press back up by extending the elbows
Use light weight; don't bounce at the bottom

exercises.name: Triceps Dip
exercises.instructions:
Grip bars, arms locked, shoulders down
Keep torso upright, legs under you
Lower until elbows reach about 90°
Press back up to lockout
Keep elbows tucked; don't lean forward

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.instructions:
Hands on bench edge behind you, fingers forward
Legs extended or bent, hips close to the bench
Lower until elbows reach about 90°
Press back up to straight arms
Don't sink too deep or let shoulders roll forward

exercises.name: Seated Dip Machine
exercises.instructions:
Set seat so handles start at your sides
Sit tall, back against the pad
Press down until arms are straight
Return slowly to about 90°
Don't shrug or lean forward

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions:
Set the back pad so knees line up with the pivot
Ankle pad just above your feet
Extend legs until straight, squeezing quads
Lower slowly under control
Don't swing or lift hips off the seat

exercises.name: Single-Leg Extension
exercises.instructions:
Set knee in line with the pivot, pad above one ankle
Hold the handles, sit tall
Extend the leg until straight
Lower slowly under control
Don't swing; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Sissy Squat
exercises.instructions:
Hold a support for balance, rise onto your toes
Lean back, keeping hips and torso in a line
Bend knees forward and lower slowly
Drive up through the quads to the start
Go only as deep as you can control

exercises.name: Reverse Nordic
exercises.instructions:
Kneel upright, knees hip-width, toes tucked or flat
Squeeze glutes, body straight from knees to head
Lean back slowly, hinging only at the knees
Pull back up to upright with your quads
Keep hips extended; don't bend at the waist

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.instructions:
Lie face down, knees just off the pad edge
Ankle pad just above your heels
Curl heels toward your glutes
Lower slowly to almost straight
Keep hips pressed down; don't swing

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.instructions:
Set back pad so knees line up with the pivot
Lock the thigh pad down snugly
Curl heels down and under the seat
Return slowly to almost straight
Keep hips in the seat; don't jerk

exercises.name: Standing Single-Leg Curl
exercises.instructions:
Stand on the machine, knee in line with the pivot
Ankle pad behind your lower calf
Curl heel toward your glute
Lower slowly under control
Keep hips still; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Dumbbell Leg Curl
exercises.instructions:
Lie face down on a bench, knees at the edge
Squeeze a dumbbell securely between your feet
Curl heels toward your glutes
Lower slowly to almost straight
Use light weight; keep hips on the bench

exercises.name: Banded Leg Curl
exercises.instructions:
Anchor band low, loop it around your ankles
Lie face down or stand holding support
Curl heel toward your glutes
Return slowly against the band
Keep hips down; don't swing

exercises.name: Slider Leg Curl
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your back, heels on sliders, knees bent
Lift hips into a bridge
Slide heels out until legs are almost straight
Pull heels back in while keeping hips up
Don't let hips drop during the rep

exercises.name: Nordic Curl
exercises.instructions:
Kneel with ankles secured under a pad or partner
Body straight from knees to head, glutes tight
Lower forward as slowly as you can
Catch yourself with your hands, push back up
Keep hips extended; don't bend at the waist

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.instructions:
Set foot plate so knees sit just behind the pad
Start upright, body straight
Lower forward under control by straightening knees
Pull back up with hamstrings and glutes
Keep hips extended; don't pike at the waist

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.instructions:
Sit tall, pads on the outside of your knees
Hold the handles, back against the pad
Push knees out as far as you can control
Return slowly without the stack touching
Don't rock your torso to move the weight

exercises.name: Cable Hip Abduction
exercises.instructions:
Ankle strap on outside leg, stand side-on to the pulley
Hold the frame, stand tall
Sweep the leg out to the side
Return slowly under control
Don't lean or rotate; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Banded Lateral Walk
exercises.instructions:
Band around knees or ankles, feet hip-width
Quarter squat, chest up
Step sideways, keeping tension in the band
Take steady steps, then go back the other way
Don't let feet come together or knees cave

exercises.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your side, legs straight and stacked
Bottom knee bent for balance if needed
Lift top leg up, toes pointing forward
Lower slowly under control
Don't roll your hips back; switch sides after

exercises.name: Banded Clamshell
exercises.instructions:
Band above knees, lie on your side, knees bent
Hips stacked, feet together
Open top knee by squeezing your glute
Lower slowly under control
Don't roll your hips back; switch sides after

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
exercises.instructions:
Sit tall, pads on the inside of your knees
Start from a comfortable wide position
Squeeze knees together
Return slowly to the start
Don't jerk or rock the torso

exercises.name: Cable Hip Adduction
exercises.instructions:
Ankle strap on inside leg, stand side-on to the pulley
Hold the frame, stand tall
Sweep the leg across in front of the other
Return slowly under control
Don't lean or twist; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
exercises.instructions:
Lie on your side, top leg resting on a bench
Forearm under shoulder, body in a straight line
Lift hips so bottom leg comes off the floor
Hold, keeping hips stacked
Use the knee version to scale; switch sides

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.instructions:
Shoulders under the pads, balls of feet on the edge
Stand tall, knees straight but not locked
Rise as high as you can on your toes
Lower slowly to a deep stretch
Pause at the bottom; don't bounce

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.instructions:
Sit with knee pad snug on lower thighs
Balls of feet on the platform edge
Release the lock and rise high onto your toes
Lower slowly to a deep stretch
Pause at the bottom; don't bounce

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
exercises.instructions:
Sit in the leg press, balls of feet on bottom edge
Legs straight, knees soft, keep safeties engaged
Push through toes to extend the ankles
Lower slowly to a deep stretch
Don't bend the knees or let feet slip

exercises.name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
exercises.instructions:
Bar on upper back, balls of feet on a raised plate
Unhook and stand tall
Rise as high as you can onto your toes
Lower slowly to a deep stretch
Pause at the bottom; don't bounce

exercises.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
exercises.instructions:
Stand on one foot on a step, dumbbell in same hand
Hold support with the other hand
Rise as high as you can on your toes
Lower slowly to a deep stretch
Don't bounce; switch legs after the set

exercises.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
exercises.instructions:
Stand on a step edge, hold support for balance
Feet hip-width, knees straight
Rise as high as you can on your toes
Lower slowly to a deep stretch
Pause at top and bottom; don't bounce

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions:
Forearms under shoulders, legs straight
Squeeze glutes and brace abs
Keep a straight line from head to heels
Breathe steadily while holding
Don't let hips sag or pike up

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instructions:
Lie on back, arms up, knees bent at 90° over hips
Press lower back flat into the floor
Extend opposite arm and leg slowly
Return and switch sides
Don't let lower back arch off the floor

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.instructions:
Lie on back, press lower back into the floor
Lift shoulders and legs off the floor
Reach arms overhead, legs straight and low
Hold, breathing steadily
Bend knees to scale if your back lifts

exercises.name: Barbell Rollout
exercises.instructions:
Kneel holding a loaded bar under your shoulders
Brace abs and squeeze glutes
Roll forward slowly, keeping a straight line
Pull back to start using your abs
Don't let hips sag or lower back arch

exercises.name: Body Saw
exercises.instructions:
Forearm plank with feet on sliders or a towel
Brace abs and squeeze glutes
Push body back a few inches from your shoulders
Pull forward to the start
Keep a straight line; don't let hips sag

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.instructions:
Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat
Hands by temples or across chest
Curl shoulders off the floor, ribs toward hips
Lower slowly under control
Don't pull on your neck

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.instructions:
Lie on back, knees bent, hands by your sides
Lift knees toward your chest
Curl hips off the floor using your abs
Lower slowly without dropping your feet
Don't swing your legs for momentum

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
exercises.instructions:
Lie on back, hands under hips or at your sides
Press lower back into the floor
Raise straight legs up toward vertical
Lower slowly without arching
Stop before your lower back lifts

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions:
Kneel facing the high pulley, rope by your head
Hips stay still, slightly back
Curl down, bringing elbows toward your knees
Return slowly, feeling your abs stretch
Don't pull with your arms or sit back on heels

exercises.name: Machine Crunch
exercises.instructions:
Set seat so the pads sit comfortably
Grip handles and brace
Crunch forward, curling your torso
Return slowly under control
Don't pull with your arms

exercises.name: Decline Sit-Up
exercises.instructions:
Hook feet under the pads of a decline bench
Hands across chest or by temples
Curl up toward your knees
Lower slowly under control
Don't yank on your neck or drop back fast

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.instructions:
Hang from the bar with straight arms, shoulders active
Brace core, legs still
Raise knees toward your chest
Lower slowly under control
Don't swing; pause at the bottom if needed

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions:
Hang from the bar, shoulders active, legs together
Brace your core
Raise straight legs to hip height or higher
Lower slowly under control
Don't swing or kip the legs up

exercises.name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
exercises.instructions:
Forearms on pads, back against the support
Let legs hang straight down
Raise knees toward your chest
Lower slowly under control
Don't swing or arch off the back pad

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.instructions:
Set cable at chest height, stand side-on
Hold handle at your chest, feet hip-width
Press arms straight out in front
Hold, resisting the rotation, then return
Keep hips and shoulders square; switch sides

exercises.name: Banded Pallof Press
exercises.instructions:
Anchor band at chest height, stand side-on
Hold band at your chest, feet hip-width
Press arms straight out in front
Hold, resist the pull, then return
Don't twist toward the anchor; switch sides

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.instructions:
Set pulley high, stand side-on, feet wide
Grip handle with both hands, arms extended
Pull diagonally down across your body
Pivot back foot, rotate through your torso
Return slowly; switch sides after the set

exercises.name: Landmine Rotation
exercises.instructions:
Hold the bar end overhead with straight arms
Feet shoulder width, core braced
Rotate the bar down to one hip in an arc
Bring it back over center to the other side
Rotate from your torso; don't bend your arms

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.instructions:
Sit with knees bent, lean back slightly
Keep chest up and back straight
Rotate torso to touch beside each hip
Move under control side to side
Don't round your back; keep feet down to scale

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.instructions:
Forearm under shoulder, legs stacked
Lift hips into a straight line
Brace abs and squeeze glutes
Hold, breathing steadily
Don't let hips sag; switch sides after
